# Oljepriset stiger på nytt – stora skillnader i vinstestimaten

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon, 8 October 2026: the oil price is climbing back above USD 100 on reports of renewed US-Iran escalation, and Stockholm turns lower during the show even though guests Joel Backesten (fund manager, Danske Bank) and Martin Blomgren (EFN analyst) say they are optimistic about the Q3 reporting season. US S&P 500 earnings are expected to grow about 30%, while Swedish small-cap earnings estimates have stopped falling. The guests are negative on real estate as interest rates rise and positive on Swedish niche software that has lagged the US rebound (Vitec), on Clas Ohlson's operational turnaround and on Alligo's operating leverage, but they are cautious about new listings such as Prisjakt.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Joel calls it 'a monster'. Same valuation as H&M but growing 12%, with a strong balance sheet, high cash flow, easy comparison figures and possible larger extra dividends.

#### Reasoning

Guest Joel Backesten (Danske) is positive: the CEO-driven turnaround focuses on five categories and the company has grown in all three countries without expanding abroad. The rise is not driven by gross margin, which is down on a comparable basis, so this is operational delivery rather than luck. It trades at the same multiple as the shrinking H&M. Its stores still need renovation, for example in Finland. Martin Blomgren agrees, noting easy comparisons from last autumn's dip. Main risks are slow

#### Sell Triggers

- if CEO Kristofer Thornström leaves
- if growth decelerates materially
- if valuation re-rates well above peers

> *"Kollar man på siffrorna på Clas Ohlson så är det ett monster."*

---

### ⛔ HM-B — H&M | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

About 1% growth, cautious Q4 guidance amid campaigns, closing stores and three years of negative growth. 'No short-term improvement.'

#### Reasoning

Both guests see H&M's margin gains under the new CEO as insufficient without growth. The latest report confirms the lack of growth and Q4 guidance is cautious. They contrast it unfavourably with Clas Ohlson at the same valuation.

> *"Så att ingen kortsiktig ljusning där heller."*

---

### 🟢 VIT-B — Vitec | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Joel's Danske fund bought back in during the spring. Niche vertical software with low AI risk, trading near an all-time-low multiple.

#### Reasoning

US software has rebounded after the AI sell-off but Swedish software lags, which creates opportunities. Vitec's niche software (for example golf club bookings) is too small for customers to vibe-code their own. AI may let Vitec cut staff and add features. It trades at about half the price of earlier this year.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI disrupts niche vertical software
- if customers start building in-house

> *"Den aktien handlas kring all time low, om du kollar multipelmässigt."*

---

### 🟢 ALLIGO-B — Alligo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Asked whether to buy, Martin says 'yes'. Joel agrees: 40% incremental EBIT margin when volumes return, plus upside from lifting Norway/Finland margins.

#### Reasoning

It has had three years of negative organic growth with exposure to construction and infrastructure. The case rests on a market recovery and on lifting Norway/Finland margins towards Swedish levels. With a 40% gross margin, extra volume flows straight through to profit. Cost cuts are done. It looks very cheap if volumes come back, but Martin admits he has thought so for two to three years. A new CEO was appointed in the summer.

#### Sell Triggers

- if construction volumes fail to recover
- if Norway/Finland margin plan stalls
- if new CEO changes strategy

> *"Ska man le och köpa Aligo? Ja, det tycker jag."*

---

### 🟠 BTS-B — BTS | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Narrative flipped in the spring from the biggest AI loser to the biggest winner after it revealed Anthropic as a customer. The stock has run since then.

#### Reasoning

Cited as an example of how fast AI narratives turn. No explicit recommendation was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI narrative reverses

> *"exakt som vi nämnde i BTS som var största förloraren i februari, nu är den största vinnaren."*

---

### 🟠 ATT — Attendo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down about 5% after a cited analyst cut the recommendation from buy to hold.

#### Reasoning

The cited analyst downgraded Attendo to hold from buy. The hosts gave no view of their own.

> *"Där har man fått en sänkt rekommendation till behåll från tidigare köp."*

---
